simplified.summary: Click the same analog drive pad to set thrust. Side buttons extend/retract red, choose the yellow high end, and prime the blue contact spring. Click the spring rail to aim and release a loaded coil.

full.summary: Drag the analog stick from its current handle. Click the scene red, yellow end and blue actuator surfaces; right-click red to retract. Drag the spring handle; pointer release fires a loaded coil.
